description: Stop Zibloh API keys (zbl_…) pasted into a prompt before Claude sees them.

hooks.command: if grep -qE 'zbl_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}'; then echo 'That message contains a Zibloh API key (zbl_...), so it was not sent. Revoke that key in Configuración de empresa -> API Keys. You do not need keys here: ask Claude to log you in and approve it in the browser.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
